children: Parth Jindal has been appointed as the Chairman of JSW MG Motor India Private Limited.
The Board of Directors of JSW MG Motor India Private Limited has appointed Parth Jindal as the Chairman of the company, effective immediately, as announced by the company.
Jindal, a member of the JSW MG Motor India board since the inception of the joint venture, has been a part of the automaker's development, product strategy, and expanding manufacturing capabilities.

JSW MG Motor India is a collaboration between JSW Group and SAIC Motor, merging JSW's insights into the Indian market with SAIC's global automotive knowledge. The company has successfully sold over 150,000 electric vehicles since its initial launch, with the MG ZS recognised as India's best-selling EV, and it positions itself as the leading EV manufacturer in the country.

In addition to his role at JSW MG Motor India, he holds multiple positions within the JSW Group: Managing Director of JSW Cement, Managing Director of JSW Paints, Chairman of JSW Dulux Limited, and Director on the Board of JSW Energy. He is also the founder of JSW Sports and serves as chairman and co-owner of the Delhi Capitals.

Jindal is the youngest among the three children of Sajjan Jindal and Sangita Jindal. He attended Cathedral and John Connon School in Mumbai and Sevenoaks School in England. In 2012, he obtained a BA in economics and political science from Brown University, followed by an MBA from Harvard Business School in 2016.

title: Parth Jindal takes over as JSW MG Motor India chairman after board approves immediate appointment
